entries.full_claim: E(z)=min{M,inf_i[U_i+L d(z,s_i)]} is the pointwise largest undetected-effect upper envelope implied by bounded L-Lipschitz regularity and tested upper bounds.
entries.domain: Any declared metric context space and nonempty tested set; executable finite-line checks.
all_premises: e is L-Lipschitz in the declared physical context metric
every U_i is a valid upper bound at actual tested s_i
same frozen effect definition across contexts
entries.proof_or_source: Note §3; cone inequality and same-constant infimum extension; 3,896 finite envelopes and 18,536 pointwise checks.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Metric, L and U_i are empirical/physical premises; pointwise sharpness means no smaller bound follows without another premise.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Abacus/calculator narrow operand region separates random prevalence from worst-case effect.

entries.full_claim: A coarse observed label and a null test at one hidden representative do not nontrivially bound the effect at another context in the same observed fiber.
entries.domain: Two hidden contexts mapped to one observed label, one tested context, effect range [0,M].
entries.proof_or_source: e0=(0,0) and e1=(0,M) have identical tested/observed objects.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: A validated section and fiber-deviation bound can add information.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Copy/swap interfaces can match sampled laws while hidden route differs.

entries.full_claim: A delta-bounded section with C-Lipschitz lift and observed fill h_X yields actual fill at most delta+C h_X and effect upper min{M,eta+L(delta+C h_X)}.
entries.domain: One common actual/observed metric application satisfying every lift and effect premise.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Observed-label equality does not supply delta=0; a vacuous delta or L gives a vacuous bound.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Human-realized-agent case keeps task labels separate from nested device/body contexts.

entries.full_claim: Under independent mu-context draws and sensitivity at least s_min, no-detection probability is at most (1-s_min p)^n and inverts to the stated one-sided affected-mass upper bound.
entries.domain: Fixed affected set, independent draws and fixed sensitivity floor.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §6; binomial multiplication/inversion; 1,100 exact fraction cases.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Does not bound maximum amplitude, zero-mass contexts or actual closure.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Ancestor/formation preserves rare actual contexts despite low prevalence.

entries.full_claim: The complete R166/R167 actual witness plus every R168 stochastic effect, regularity, coverage and triage premise refines W4-W5 for the same declared operational relation only.
entries.domain: One common actual episode and fixed stochastic certificate.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §8 and explicit all-of map rule.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: No actual system, neural completeness, C1 derivation, B_min validation, necessity or basal-experience inference.
entries.thought_experiment_role: All four families audit rare contexts, nested hidden states, route actuality and report independence.
